faqs.q: Do you work with my insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with every major carrier, handle the claim directly with your adjuster, and keep you out of the back-and-forth.
We keep a few loaners on hand and can help set up a rental through your claim. Ask when you drop the car off.

faqs.q: How long will my repair take?
faqs.a: A bumper or small panel is usually a few days; heavier collision and frame work runs one to two weeks. You get a real timeline at drop-off.
Our paint and refinishing carry a lifetime warranty for as long as you own the vehicle, and body and structural repairs are guaranteed too.
Always. Bring the car by or send photos and we'll write up a free estimate, no obligation.
